name: Rockwell Automation
summary: Two routes remain distinct: GuardianAI analyses PowerFlex current locally; Augury documents multi-sensor diagnosis and a separate partnership connecting recommendations to Fiix MAX. Augury's fusion capability does not establish GuardianAI's inputs or a GuardianAI-to-Fiix pipeline.

flows.name: PowerFlex to GuardianAI

steps.label: PowerFlex drive current
steps.detail: Supported 755/755T-family and 6000T drives provide three-phase current data for motor-current signature analysis of driven equipment.

steps.label: Control-network edge host
steps.detail: GuardianAI runs on a local VM or edge device and connects to a drive by IP address or a routed CIP path.

steps.label: GuardianAI
steps.detail: The machine-learning application learns operating baselines and detects and identifies deviations; engineers can label previously unidentified cases.

steps.label: Maintenance alert or Logix tag
steps.detail: Users receive anomaly notifications; release 1.04 can optionally write diagnostic insights to a ControlLogix or CompactLogix UDT for downstream consumers.

flows.caveat: Drive-based coverage is scoped to supported VFD applications; the cited materials do not establish fixed-speed motor coverage or a native Fiix connection.

flows.name: Augury to Fiix maintenance workflow

steps.label: Augury multi-sensor evidence
steps.detail: Augury documents vibration, temperature, magnetic flux and ultrasound capabilities. The Fiix announcement does not specify which sensing configuration each integration uses.

steps.label: Augury diagnosis and Reliability Agent
steps.detail: Machine Health combines signals to corroborate findings, with ML baselines covering speed and load changes. The partnership names the Reliability Agent for recommendations.

steps.label: Fiix MAX and CMMS
steps.detail: Fiix MAX translates recommendations into maintenance workflows and work orders; FactoryTalk Optix is named in the joint portfolio.

flows.caveat: This is a separately announced partner route, not proof that GuardianAI findings pass through Augury or that every integration is generally available.

evidence_fusion.assessment: Augury explicitly describes signals providing context and confirmation for one another in diagnosis. Its models account for operating speed and load.
evidence_fusion.limits: These are Augury Machine Health capabilities. The Rockwell partnership does not establish every installed sensor, transport route or fusion configuration, and they must not be attributed to GuardianAI. Missing/conflicting-signal policy is not established here.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §7: GuardianAI uses PowerFlex drive electrical telemetry and runs at the edge.
findings.assessment: Rockwell documents the supported drives, local deployment and baseline-based machine-learning analysis.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-landscape-eight-majors.md §2 and conclusion: GuardianAI is a named deterministic algorithm, not machine learning.
findings.assessment: Rockwell explicitly calls GuardianAI a machine-learning supervisory application; the archive's all-vendors deterministic generalisation is unsound for this product.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §7: GuardianAI can write results to ControlLogix UDTs.
findings.assessment: Release 1.04 added optional writes to a custom UDT on ControlLogix or CompactLogix; this is an output route, not proof of automatic Fiix integration.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §7: Augury partnership proves Rockwell's internal vibration algorithms lagged and Augury diagnosis feeds Fiix MAX and FactoryTalk Optix.
findings.assessment: The July 2026 announcement supports the Reliability Agent-to-Fiix MAX partnership and names FactoryTalk Optix in the portfolio. It does not make a comparative algorithm-quality admission or specify a direct diagnostic feed to Optix.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §7: GuardianAI is completely blind to all fixed-speed motors and passive gearboxes.
findings.assessment: Rockwell's cited GuardianAI documentation describes supported VFD-fed applications. The universal wording about all fixed-speed or passive equipment was not established by these sources.

unknowns: Augury documents multi-sensor capabilities; the partnership announcement does not identify the installed sensor configuration, transport or deployment for a particular Augury-Fiix integration.
No cited source establishes GuardianAI-to-Fiix/MAX as a packaged direct connection.
